쭉.forms: 쭉 가세요 · 쭉 가다가 왼쪽으로 · 쭉 살았어요
쭉.ex: 이 길로 쭉 가면 지하철역이 나와요.
쭉.x: If you go straight down this road, you'll come to the subway station.
쭉.e: A sound-and-feel word suggesting one long, unbroken stretch.
쭉.t: It also means "the whole time": 어릴 때부터 쭉 서울에서 살았어요.

방금.x: I just got home a moment ago, too.
방금.t: 방금 points to the very recent past; 금방 usually means 'soon' or 'quickly'.

조금씩.m: little by little, a bit at a time, gradually
조금씩.x: My Korean is getting better little by little.
조금씩.t: 한 개씩 'one each', 두 명씩 'two at a time'.

생기다.m: to come into being, to be newly made; to happen, to arise; to get, to have; to look (a certain way)
생기다.x: A new cafe opened in front of the school.
생기다.t: Use the past for states: 남자 친구가 생겼어요 = 'I've got a boyfriend.'

그렇게.forms: 그렇게 + verb/adjective: 그렇게 해요 · 그렇게 비싸요?
그렇게.m: like that, that way; so, that much
그렇게.ex: 그렇게 하면 더 빨리 끝날 거예요.
그렇게.x: If you do it that way, you'll finish faster.
그렇게.t: 그렇게 할게요 = I'll do that — a polite way to agree. Pronounced [그러케].

그렇지만.ex: 그렇지만 아직 숙제를 다 못 했어요.
그렇지만.x: But I still haven't finished my homework.
그렇지만.t: Pronounced [그러치만] — ㅎ and ㅈ merge into ㅊ.

액세서리.ex: 이 옷에는 간단한 액세서리가 잘 어울려요.
액세서리.x: Simple accessories go well with this outfit.
액세서리.e: From English 'accessory'; often spelled 악세사리 in casual writing, but 액세서리 is standard.

빙수.ex: 더운 날에는 친구랑 빙수를 나눠 먹어요.
빙수.x: On hot days, I share bingsu with a friend.
빙수.t: The classic is 팥빙수 with sweet red beans. One bowl is usually shared by two or more people.

식비.ex: 혼자 살면 식비가 생각보다 많이 들어요.
식비.x: When you live alone, food costs more than you'd think.

악플.ex: 그 가수는 악플 때문에 많이 힘들어했어요.
악플.x: The singer had a really hard time because of hateful comments.
악플.e: Short for 악성 리플: 악 'evil' + 플 from English 'reply'.

공개.x: The police decided to release the criminal's face.
공개.t: Useful collocations: 정보 공개 'disclosure of information', 공개 사과 'public apology', 공개되다 'to be released'.

등교.m: going to school, arriving at school
등교.ex: 아이들은 매일 아침 여덟 시에 등교해요.
등교.x: The kids go to school at eight every morning.
등교.t: 등교하다 and 하교하다 mirror 출근하다 and 퇴근하다 for workers.

복제.x: Scientists succeeded in cloning a sheep.
복제.t: 불법 복제 means piracy, like illegally copied software or movies.

안쓰럽다.m: pitiful, heartbreaking to watch, feeling sorry for
안쓰럽다.x: I feel so sorry for my younger sibling, who works until late at night.
안쓰럽다.t: Used for people you care about who are struggling; it sounds warmer and less condescending than 불쌍하다.

충실하다.x: He is always faithful to his work.
충실하다.t: A homonym 충실하다 means 'solid, substantial,' as in 내용이 충실하다.

촉진하다.m: to promote, to accelerate, to stimulate
촉진하다.ex: 물을 많이 마시면 소화를 촉진할 수 있어요.
촉진하다.x: Drinking lots of water can aid digestion.

잠재력.ex: 이 학생은 성장할 잠재력이 매우 커요.
잠재력.x: This student has great potential to grow.

장보기.x: My husband usually does the weekend grocery shopping.
장보기.e: From 장을 보다, literally 'to see the market': to go food shopping.
장보기.t: As a verb, say 장을 보다 (장 보러 가요), not 장보기를 하다, in everyday speech.

청렴.x: The most important virtue for a public official is integrity.
청렴.t: Pronounced [청념] — ㄹ after ㅇ becomes ㄴ; the adjective is 청렴하다.

공제.ex: 병원비는 세금 공제를 받을 수 있어요.
공제.x: You can get a tax deduction for medical bills.

적대.ex: 오랜 적대 관계를 끝내기는 쉽지 않습니다.
적대.x: It isn't easy to end a long hostile relationship.

국산화.m: localization of production, domestic production (replacing imports)
국산화.ex: 그 회사는 핵심 부품의 국산화에 성공했습니다.
국산화.x: The company succeeded in producing key parts domestically.

납품.m: delivery of goods (to a client), supply
납품.ex: 이번 주까지 부품 납품을 마쳐야 합니다.
납품.x: We have to finish delivering the parts by this week.
납품.t: Pronounced [납품]; it's B2B delivery under contract, not parcel delivery (택배).

국보.x: Sungnyemun was National Treasure No. 1 of Korea.
국보.t: Korea officially dropped the numbering in 2021, but many people still say 국보 제1호.

고생 끝에 낙이 온다.forms: 고생 끝에 낙이 온다고 · 고생 끝에 낙이 온다잖아요
고생 끝에 낙이 온다.m: after hardship comes happiness; no pain, no gain
고생 끝에 낙이 온다.ex: 고생 끝에 낙이 온다고, 3년 동안 준비한 시험에 드디어 합격했어요.
고생 끝에 낙이 온다.x: After hardship comes happiness: I finally passed the exam I'd prepared for over three years.
고생 끝에 낙이 온다.e: Literally 'at the end of hardship, joy comes'.
고생 끝에 낙이 온다.t: The native-sounding counterpart of the four-character idiom 고진감래. Used to comfort someone in a hard time, or looking back after success.
nb: 가는 말이 고와야 오는 말이 곱다

자치단체장.m: head of a local government (mayor, governor, county chief)
자치단체장.ex: 이번 선거에서 새로운 자치단체장이 많이 뽑혔어요.
자치단체장.x: Many new local government heads were elected in this election.

자유무역협정.x: Korea has signed free trade agreements with many countries.
자유무역협정.e: Literally 'a fixed cooperation on free trade'.
자유무역협정.t: In everyday news it's usually just called FTA (에프티에이).

과체중.x: The doctor said being overweight is bad for your health.
과체중.t: 과체중 is milder than 비만 (obesity); doctors use both as separate categories.

양산.ex: 새 모델은 내년 초부터 양산에 들어갑니다.
양산.x: The new model goes into mass production early next year.
양산.e: Short for 대량 생산 'large-quantity production.' Homonym warning: 양산 also means a parasol.
양산.t: 양산에 들어가다 'go into mass production' is the standard news phrase.

백자.ex: 조선 시대에는 깨끗하고 단순한 백자가 크게 유행했어요.
백자.x: In the Joseon era, clean and simple white porcelain was hugely popular.
백자.t: Remember the pair: 고려청자 (Goryeo celadon) and 조선백자 (Joseon white porcelain).

광활하다.x: An endless, vast desert spread out before our eyes.

배타성.ex: 그 집단의 배타성 때문에 새로운 사람이 적응하기 힘들어요.
배타성.x: Because the group is so exclusive, it's hard for newcomers to fit in.
배타성.e: Literally 'the quality of pushing others away'.
